who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers;’
You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. You split the earth with rivers.
The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared…

translations.web: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
translations.bsb: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
translations.kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
translations.asv: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.
